This name is associated with love, beauty, and joy, and is often used to evoke feelings of nostalgia and longing for the divine. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Vraj usually hope their child will grow to embody the abode of krishna and live with faith, good character and purpose.
